product.title: Product
product.appliesTo: Interfaces: the app, dashboards and tools

do.text: Keep what each screen or asset is for: its headline and its one action stay the most prominent things.
Visible focus on every control (a 2px White outline); touch targets at least 44px on phones.
Feedback on pointer: a fill change and the button glow; buttons hold their size on press and on hover, as the site's do.

dont.text: Shadows, gradients other than the light, a colored ground, a second accent color, the spectrum as text color, bold (600+) weights, other companies' logos or photos, stretched, recolored, outlined, rotated or effected logos, the light inside a box with hard edges, filtered or graded photos, emoji, exclamation marks.

rules.text: Black is the ground. Surfaces are Black (#000000); a card is #262626 on Black with a 4px corner (8px for controls, fields and plan tiers; #171717 with a 10px corner only on the 1080 canvas). Separate with a fill or a hairline (#363636 on Black, #4D4D4D on a surface), never a shadow.
Type is White. Secondary text comes from the neutral steps (#D4D4D4, #A3A3A3, #858585); #4D4D4D and darker are never text. Pick grays from the 15 neutral steps, never by eye.
Most screens use only Black and White. The spectrum colors (Magenta, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue) come from the brand light and small accents; when shown together they keep that order.

Funnel Display at 450 for page and section heads and at 400 for card titles and subheads, each line 4px taller than its size (56/60, 44/48, 32/36, 24/28, 20/24); DM Sans at optical size 14, Regular for body (16/24) and captions, Medium for labels, badges and buttons; labels in capitals with 6% letter spacing. Weights 400, 450 and 500 only.

The primary button is a White fill with a Black DM Sans Medium 14/20 label, an 8px corner, 40px tall (36px in the header, 56px large; 56px with a 10px corner on the canvas). One primary button per view; secondary is the quiet button (#1A1A1A inside a #363636 ring), ghost has no fill until hovered. Under a mouse a White glow follows the pointer.
The search bar is a Black field with a hairline, the prompt in White DM Sans and a White "Search" button inside.

Motion is quick and quiet, on the site's ease-out (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1): 160ms color changes, 240ms entrances, 360ms for a dialog or menu panel and 280ms to close it, never ease-in, hover only behind (hover: hover), reduced motion keeps opacity and color. Icons never move on hover.

website.title: Website and assets
website.appliesTo: Web pages, social posts, ads, decks, banners and merch

do.text: Keep what each screen or asset is for: its headline and its one action stay the most prominent things.
Visible focus on every control (a 2px White outline); touch targets at least 44px on phones.
Feedback on pointer: a fill change and the button glow; buttons hold their size on press and on hover, as the site's do.

dont.text: Shadows, gradients other than the light, a colored ground, a second accent color, the spectrum as text color, bold (600+) weights, other companies' logos or photos, stretched, recolored, outlined, rotated or effected logos, the light inside a box with hard edges, filtered or graded photos, emoji, exclamation marks.

rules.text: The light (the brand pattern) is one shape drawn three times in Red #DF0000 at 0.85, Green #00FF29 at 0.782 and Blue #1B1DFF at 0.782, each offset sideways, blurred and blended plus-lighter on Black, so the colors separate at the edges and turn pale where they overlap. It flows in from the edges and corners of a layout, never boxed in, with a main mass and a smaller counterpart elsewhere.

The ASCII texture is a field of Geist Mono characters (" .:-=+*#") from a soft heat map, on Black, at 0.35 opacity, behind the light (0.5 for a field on the site, 0.32 faint). It is an accent, never the main graphic, kept clear of text, the logo and photos, with soft edges.

Imagery is real creative (ads, product shots, UGC) in its posted color: no grading, filters or neon. Photos sit on Black with the light behind or between them. Examples and templates use Acme placeholders or supplied images, never another brand's photos or a real person's name.

Layouts: the lockup top left (or centered), the headline in Funnel Display, a White button bottom left and "spyglass.so" bottom right. Margins are 64px on ads, 72px on posts, 96px on decks (1080px and 1920px canvases).

Logo: the logomark (a rounded rectangle with a lens cut out), the 3D logomark, the wordmark, horizontal and vertical combination marks and the 3D combination marks. Primary background is Black with a White mark; secondary backgrounds are White (Black mark), Blue, Red and Magenta (White mark), Yellow and Green (Black mark). Clear space is half the logomark's height on all four sides (a minimum); minimum heights are 16px for the logomark and the horizontal combination mark, 32px for the vertical one.
